
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/AronKeener/p/20099412" title="发布于 2026-05-20 21:41">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">力扣之路01—两数之和</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
题干：
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2347440/202605/2347440-20260520200209420-861474525.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;思路：</p>
<p>① 一开始做这道题的时候，我粗心了一下，就是数组下标那里没看到；</p>
<p>② 然后尝试了增强型for循环，但不是很适用，所以采用了两个for循环嵌套在一起的方式；</p>
<p>③ 画蛇添足的是我一开始写了个判断，在第一层for循环中，在那个循环里我想着如果遍历的某个元素大于输入的数字，那么就应该跳过这个元素去往下一个元素，但这种思路忽略了数组里本身可能是负数，输入的值也是负数的情况，所以我去掉了这个if判断</p>
<p>④ 以下是我自己的代码</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Solution {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>[] twoSum(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>[] nums, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> target) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>[] answerNum = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>[2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 例：[0,1,2,3,4,5]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ① 选择0，然后依次和后面几个相加，
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ② 选择1，然后依次和后面几个相加。
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 判断这俩元素相加的结果是否等于 target</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = 0 ; i &lt; nums.length ; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">){
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 一开始我在这里加了个判断，但这个判断忽视了负数的情况
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> if (target &lt;= nums[0]){continue;}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 依次进行累加判断，然后将数组下表装入数组中再返回</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(i &lt; nums.length-1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">){
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> j=i+1 ; j &lt; nums.length ; j++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">){
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>                     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(nums[i] + nums[j] ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> target){
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>                         answerNum[0] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> i;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>                         answerNum[1] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> j;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> answerNum;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> }        </pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>直观但是不够优雅，执行用时49ms，消耗内存46.4MB，随后跟着讲解写了下面这段代码：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Solution {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>[] twoSum(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>[] nums, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> target) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">传入数组的长度</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> len =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> nums.length;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">初始化一个哈希表
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">初始化时为防止内存浪费，给定容量
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">我的思路：之所以是len-1，是因为下标是从0开始数的</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>         Map&lt;Integer, Integer&gt; hashMap = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> HashMap&lt;&gt;(len - 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">第一个元素之前一定没有元素与之对应，因此直接将num[0]和它的下标0存入哈希表
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">后续如果发生不符合条件的，会重新往 hashMap 里 put 一个新的数据用以覆盖原数据，把这个hashMap 当作一个放食物的盘子就好</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>         hashMap.put(nums[0] , 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>         
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">从第二个元素，也就是下标为1的元素那里开始遍历
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">每遍历一个元素都看看有没有元素符合target - num[i] 的，</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i=1; i &lt; len ; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">){
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> another = target-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">nums[i];
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果哈希表中存在这个元素</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(hashMap.containsKey(another)){
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">返回这两个数对应的下标（把这两个数对应的下标存在一个 int 数组中）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[]{i, hashMap.get(another)};
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果哈希表中不包含这个元素，就直接覆盖hashMap，
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 可以理解为如果食物不合口味就倒掉，然后用这个旧盘子装新食物端上桌</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            hashMap.put(nums[i], i);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这里被卡了会儿，原因是需要有个返回值，还得是数组的
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 我没想好返回啥，就用这个给怼上了</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>[]{0, 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">};
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">31</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>后记：</p>
<p>我不知道自己能坚持多久，但我想每天下班后刷一道题，然后搞懂这道题的思路，不为别的，只为回到熟悉又喜欢的互联网行业。</p>
